_about: Frame lists for the scene-synchronization GIFs in images/generated/scene-sync/.
Every frame named here is a TRACKED capture from a physical D435 -> Isaac run;
the assembler never records anything itself and refuses a frame it cannot find,
so re-running the generator cannot replace this evidence with a generated-scenario
capture. `hold` is how many GIF frames the still is shown for at `fps`.
